answer: Every identity docks in a harbor and tends one orchard tree whose fruit ripens only through sequential proofs salted to its own address, so proofs cannot be copied or parallelized. The harbor prices each funding cluster by its delta: the trust edges crossing from that cluster outward. Every member posts a bond equal to the square of the delta, so N clones sharing one root pay N squared each and N cubed together, while one honest agent with a delta of one pays a single bond. If any tree bears false fruit, the harbor burns the whole cluster's bonds, so one fake clone sinks every ship beside it.
